name: product_error_read
purpose: TASKS 243 (README decision 65, amendment of 16 Nov 2026): the error of what the pipeline delivers - the corrected band positions of the carried seeds' mean dH - on the clean hold-out (a) and on hold-out (b), with this repository's own code; second route to probes/results_m1/aromir_product_error_2026-11-16 (the package's code), with which it must agree to 0.01 cm-1 per family and set. Writes modules/05_support_predictor/out/<carried stem>_product_error.json, the record m08/accuracy.py reads the licence from.

estimate.basis: 47 stored molecules of at most 66 atoms, three checkpoints loaded per molecule; the 249-molecule evaluation of v14_seleval_smoke took 333 s on 16 Nov 2026

memory.basis: max RSS 1.94 GB of a 249-molecule evaluation on 16 Nov 2026 (v14_seleval_smoke); this read holds one molecule at a time; beside v14_stage1's 7.7 GB that is 10.7 of 13
